meta.about: Depth-first UI system: four surface layers, paired raise/lower shadows, and a palette verified against WCAG 2.1 in both themes.

tokens.name: bg-dark
tokens.usage: Layer 0 — the page itself, and the floor of any well. Nothing sits behind it.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Layer 1 — sections and panels resting on the page. The default card ground.

tokens.name: bg-light
tokens.usage: Layer 2 — raised: cards inside panels, the selected item in a list, popovers.

tokens.name: bg-lighter
tokens.usage: Layer 3 — the highest ground. Reserve it for one element per view.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body and heading text. 11.2:1 or better on every bg layer in both themes (AAA).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, placeholder labels. 5.5:1 or better on every bg layer (AA).

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The lit top edge of a raised element. Use as a 1px inset top shadow, never as a full border.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Control boundaries that must be seen: inputs, checkboxes, toggles. 3:1 or better on every bg layer.

tokens.name: border-muted
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and table rules. Below 3:1 by design — never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring. 4.5:1 or better on every bg layer, and never the same hue as a state colour.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary action and active state. Also readable as text on any bg layer.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Second-rank action, tags, the warm counterweight to primary.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention but nothing is broken yet.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed, healthy, passing.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices and help text.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid primary fill. 5.7:1 light, 10.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid secondary fill.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid danger fill.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid warning fill.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid success fill.

tokens.name: on-info
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid info fill.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Captions and helper text. Pair with text-muted.

styles.name: num
styles.usage: Figures in a table. Set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, hairline offsets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside a chip or a dense row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside a control. The default small gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, and the page gutter on a phone.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between stacked controls.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding at desktop size, section inner gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding block.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page-level breathing room above a heading.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Hairline tags, the inner edge of a nested shape.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, checkboxes, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, list rows. The default.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large panels and the outer shell of a layered group.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: A full-bleed hero block.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, toggles, avatars.

shadow.note: Each raise pairs a light inset top edge with a dark drop below. Each lower inverts it: dark inset on top, light inset at the foot.

tokens.name: elev-1
tokens.usage: Barely off the surface: list rows, inputs, small chips. Pair with bg-light.

tokens.name: elev-2
tokens.usage: The workhorse. Cards, the selected option, a panel the eye should land on first.

tokens.name: elev-3
tokens.usage: Lifted off the page: menus, popovers, a dragged item, a card on hover.

tokens.name: recess-1
tokens.usage: Pressed in a little: progress tracks, slider rails, a pressed button.

tokens.name: recess-2
tokens.usage: A deep well: the de-emphasised table at the bottom of a dashboard, an inset code block.

tokens.name: ring-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus. Two rings so it reads on any layer. Never remove it without a replacement.

gradient.note: Alpha-only overlays, so one value is correct in both themes. Layer them over a token fill, never instead of one.

tokens.name: sheen-soft
tokens.usage: Default surface wash. Lightens the top, darkens the foot. Works unchanged in both themes.

tokens.name: sheen-strong
tokens.usage: For buttons and selects that should read as lit objects.

tokens.name: sheen-edge
tokens.usage: The glassy top band only. Layer it over a solid fill so the fill keeps its contrast.

tokens.name: well-scrim
tokens.usage: Shade falling into a recessed area, under the recess shadow.

tokens.name: ambient-glow
tokens.usage: Off-axis light on a large panel so it is never one flat field.

timing.note: Movement is a cue, not decoration. Everything here is under half a second and is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Colour and shadow changes on press.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Hover lift, panel reveal. The default.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Layout shifts and anything that moves more than 8px.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything that settles: lifts, fades, expansions.

tokens.name: ease-lift
tokens.usage: One small overshoot, for an element that pops up. Use sparingly.

tokens.name: ease-sink
tokens.usage: Pressing in. Starts slow, arrives hard, no overshoot.

lift.note: How far an element travels. Translate, never resize, so text stays crisp.

tokens.name: lift-1
tokens.usage: Press-adjacent nudge, or a row lifting under the cursor.

tokens.name: lift-2
tokens.usage: A card lifting on hover. Pairs with elev-2 going to elev-3.

tokens.name: lift-3
tokens.usage: The most any element should travel on hover.

tokens.name: sink-1
tokens.usage: Active and pressed states. Pairs with recess-1.
